issue.title: Wikilink completion in Bob's prose prompts
issue.description: Typing `[[` in any Bob-owned field that writes Markdown prose into the vault (intentions, Work/Rotten/Cancel/Schedule Log reasons, record text, notebook summaries, the Mac Pull-In reason) opens one consistent LINK band that inserts exactly the link it shows, never submits a half-typed link, never touches text after the caret, and never writes the vault. Identifier and filter fields stay literal.

S14 guards this in ledger-tools (capture-phase blur guard during paint plus setSourcePath after rebind), but S6, S10, and S15 rebind hosts need the same; a controller fix (defer the blur close and re-check activeElement against the rebound input, renderHint in rebind) would cover all of them.

Full npm test on the final tree: 8230/8237 pass. The only failures are two 25 ms wall-clock budgets (test-ledger-tools-frees-marks and event-link-times), at load average ~158; both files pass 40/40 when rerun alone on this same tree. These flakes are already tracked by task beads bob-cli-io and bob-cli-km. docs:check lint reports only the pre-existing word-budget errors on nav reference and vault-format, which om.3 already recorded and this phase did not touch.

S14 wired in bob-plugins ledger-tools 1.153.0. New fragment 297cd feature-detects nav proseField v1 and attaches it to the intention input, summary input, and reflection textarea. Options: links:true, recall:null, ownKeys:false, sourcePath getter () => modal.subjectPath, so it follows [ / ] travel. The band host is data-intention-band, directly under the field (297cc). Every paint rebinds the same handle to the rebuilt input and host. A capture-phase blur guard keeps Chromium's blur-on-removal from closing an open band mid-paint; a mutation check confirmed the guard is load-bearing. The handle is the first rung of intentionBackOut (Esc, Ctrl+[ via bobCardWireCloseKeys, onEscapeKey); q still types. intentionOnKeyDown offers stage keys to the handle after the pending-write swallow. Enter, Tab, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter accept and never save; a held Enter is swallowed; reflection Shift+Enter is still a newline. The handle detaches on stage close and modal close. Fails open with no nav, an old nav, a throwing attach, or a null handle. Tests: new test-ledger-tools-intention-card-prose-field.cjs (11 tests, fake API plus the real nav controller), all intention, record, and prose-field tests green, validate 12/12, docs inventory current, docs/intention-card.md updated.
